# libFuzzer targets (Clang, -DWA_BUILD_FUZZERS=ON, which also enables ASan/UBSan and coverage instrumentation of the
# whole build). Seed corpora are generated by generate_fuzz_seed_corpora.py; run e.g.:
#     python tests/fuzz/generate_fuzz_seed_corpora.py BUILD_DIR/fuzz_seeds
#     BUILD_DIR/wa_fuzz_wacbor_subprofile_decoder -max_total_time=600 NEW_CORPUS_DIR BUILD_DIR/fuzz_seeds/wacbor_subprofile_decoder

foreach(fuzz_target IN ITEMS wa_fuzz_wacbor_subprofile_decoder wa_fuzz_device_profile_loader)
    add_executable(${fuzz_target} ${fuzz_target}.c "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/wa_test_support.c")
    target_include_directories(${fuzz_target} PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit")
    target_link_libraries(${fuzz_target} PRIVATE wa_flightbox_internal)
    target_compile_options(${fuzz_target} PRIVATE ${WA_STRICT_WARNING_FLAGS})
    target_link_options(${fuzz_target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
    set_target_properties(${fuzz_target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}")
endforeach()
